pundit.name: Eric Wynalda
pundit.take: **Gunner is the only manager here who remotely understands soccer, and the rest of you are making me question if you've even seen a game outside of FIFA 23.** Look at the standings — Gunner sits comfortably at the top with 81 points, while the rest of you fumble around like you've never dribbled a ball in your life. "Mustard Boy" Zach, your Brazil pick might be the only thing keeping you alive, but don't think even for a second that your Tier 4 debacle with Saudi Arabia isn't embarrassing. "The Backpass Assassin" Gayden, you're hoping England and Japan can drag you out of the gutter, but your over-reliance on Tier 3 nobodies like Korea Republic is amateur hour at best. And let's talk about "The Noisemaker" Rafe, the kid who drafted three teams that didn't even qualify. This is a joke, right? You can't just recognize names and pretend you have a strategy. Stick to the video games, kid. Meanwhile, Devin, at least you have the U.S. — but relying on Bosnia and Haiti to save your bacon? That's not how this works. Embrace the fact that Gunner is your superior and start taking notes.
